raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
[by Claude Code]

## Motivation

The cookbook's **Agentic Long-Context Deployment** sections (#42726, #43083, #43799, #43983, #44065, #44228, #44654, #44712, #45039, #45111, #45311, #45513, #45749, #46005, #46506) mirror SemiAnalysis InferenceX AgentX submissions as raw launch commands, each linked to the run that measured it. The configurations are mirrored from SemiAnalysis submissions. This PR:

1. **Adds the MiniMax-M3.1-Flash B200 and GB200 HiCache points at c40, c48 and c56**, measured by the newer `/use` runs of [InferenceX #4490](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4490) and [InferenceX #4491](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4491).
2. **Syncs to InferenceX `main`** (`65a6dd19`).
3. **Overlays eight open InferenceX PRs** (table below).

## Source

[InferenceX](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX) `main` (`65a6dd19`), with these open InferenceX PRs overlaid:

| PR | Page | Lanes | Pinned to |
|---|---|---|---|
| [#4524](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4524) MiniMax-M3.1-Flash B300 SGLang TP2 | MiniMax-M3.1 | `minimaxm31flash-fp4-b300-sglang-agentic-dspark-tp2` | no `/use` yet: in progress at head `8eddada3` (same commands as at `2e12ce08` in #46506) |
| [#4491](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4491) MiniMax-M3.1-Flash GB200 SGLang | MiniMax-M3.1 | `minimaxm31flash-fp4-gb200-sglang-agentic-dspark` | [run 40252912814](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40252912814), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4491#issuecomment-6408355869) (commit `2751547f`; #46506 showed run 40176938051 at `d46a2c4f`), verified |
| [#4490](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4490) MiniMax-M3.1-Flash B200 SGLang | MiniMax-M3.1 | `minimaxm31flash-fp4-b200-sglang-agentic-dspark` | [run 40252316011](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40252316011), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4490#issuecomment-6408377612) (commit `122762e5`; #46506 showed run 40176935506 at `96b2c683`), verified |
| [#4455](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4455) Qwen3.5 FP8 H200 SGLang | Qwen3.5 | `qwen3.5-fp8-h200-sglang-agentic-mtp`, `-hicache-mtp` | no `/use` yet: in progress at head `fad84b25` (unchanged) |
| [#4434](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4434) DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 Dynamo+SGLang agg | DeepSeek-V4.1 | `dsv41flash-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg` | [run 40153045152](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40153045152), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4434#issuecomment-6409913622) (head `6e0aec9f`, same commit as in #46506), verified |
| [#4417](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4417) Muse Spark Open B300 SGLang | Muse Spark Open | `musespark-fp4-b300-sglang-agentic-dflash` | no `/use` yet: in progress at head `5422503f` (unchanged; the PR got new commits right after this PR's sources were frozen, left for the next refresh) |
| [#4346](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4346) DeepSeek-V4 NVFP4 B300 Dynamo+SGLang, Mooncake EFA KV transfer | DeepSeek-V4 | `dsv4-fp4-b300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg`, `-disagg` | [run 39910889415](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39910889415), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4346#issuecomment-6385006603) (head `34d4cd6b`, unchanged), verified |
| [#4333](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333) Qwen3.5 NVFP4 GB300 Dynamo+SGLang | Qwen3.5 | `qwen3.5-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg`, `-disagg`; retires `-agg-pareto`, `-pp-pareto` | [run 39355392627](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39355392627), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333#issuecomment-6334247978) (head `02b72dc0`, unchanged), verified |

"In progress" lanes are rendered at the PR head and labeled "In progress in SA InferenceX AgentX". A later sync pins them once the PR gets a `/use` run or merges.

- **Merged since #46506.** [InferenceX #4492](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4492) (MiniMax-M3.1-Flash B300 SGLang) merged and was ingested, so it now comes from `main`, at the same run (40178345296) and commands as before.
- **Retired keys.** [InferenceX #4333](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4333) deletes `qwen3.5-fp4-gb300-dynamo-sglang-agentic-agg-pareto` and `-pp-pareto`, as in #46506.
- **Not mirrored (unmeasured, unchanged from #46506):** `musespark-fp4-h100-sglang-agentic-dflash` and `qwen3.5-fp8-h100-sglang-agentic`. No dashboard changelog names them.
- InferenceX `main` was frozen for this PR at `65a6dd19`. Later merges are left for the next refresh.

## What this PR does

| Page | Lanes | Deployments | Points | Hardware |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MiniMax-M3.1 | 5 | 14 | 52 (was 46) | GB300, GB200, B300, B200 |
| GLM-5.2 | 14 | 34 | 75 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| GLM-5.3 | 1 | 1 | 10 | B300 |
| DeepSeek-V4 | 12 | 26 | 70 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |
| DeepSeek-V4.1 | 9 | 22 | 67 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.5 | 16 | 51 | 220 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200, H100 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 4 | 5 | 24 | GB300, B300, B200, H200 |
| Muse Spark Open | 6 | 9 | 64 | GB300, GB200, B300, B200, H200 |

- **MiniMax-M3.1-Flash B200 ([InferenceX #4490](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4490)) and GB200 ([InferenceX #4491](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4491)).** The TP4 HiCache deployment now covers c32, c40, c48, c56 and c64. The new points use the same serving flags as c32 / c64, with `--max-running-requests` and `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode` at twice the concurrency (80, 96, 112). The other deployments of both lanes keep their commands and now link the newer runs.
- **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash GB300 Dynamo+SGLang agg ([InferenceX #4434](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4434)).** Now verified by its `/use` run; the commands are unchanged.
- Every other page changes only in its source header (InferenceX `main` SHA and overlay pins). No flag rules were added.

## Validation

- Every page in a headless browser (`mint dev`, Mintlify as in CI). Every hardware / checkpoint / deployment / concurrency / KV tier / router combination renders exactly the decoded commands: 3,138 command sets, 0 mismatches, 0 unseen, no browser errors. Every tab was clicked, and every "Copy link" URL was reopened. The section links from the Deployment panels and the copy buttons were also checked.
- The component's own decoder reproduces every generated plan (3,138 router × KV-tier variants). Every KV flag exists in its image's SGLang commit (239 image × flag pairs). The round-trip / leak check reports 0 problems.
- **Arg-parse in the submission images:** all 24 commands that changed since the last validated round parse with the `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-minimax-m31-flash` image's own SGLang parser.
- `node scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs`, `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects`, `mint validate` and `pre-commit run --all-files` (in `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-cu13`) pass.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
